environment: Local production build, synthetic owner account, real Eve/Matrix delivery, Chrome desktop and 390x844 mobile viewport

focusedTests: Late acknowledgement cannot duplicate live messages
Identical messages keep separate native identities
Late failure preserves the next draft
Account cache clear blocks queued sends

limits: Memory cache only; reload/crash durability and a persistent offline outbox remain open
Cold first visits still require a network load
Eve exposes no public delivery-id or idempotency-key option; response receipt correlation uses public streams and manual retry for uncertain failures
New live events are collected but their projection waits for pending submission receipts, avoiding race-induced duplicate echoes
Expo exports and physical-device qualification were not repeated in this increment
No million-user capacity or complete-parity claim
